claims.claim: Every maximal-output-spin SU2 broadcaster marginal Phi_j has coherent canonical comparator Psi_j with I-Psi_j <= 2(I-Phi_j).
claims.quantifiers: Every half-integer j>0, every Hermitian observable; one comparator independent of observable.
claims.mechanism: Exact harmonic lambda_l=c_l(j)/c_l(2j); positive product-subset expansion gives c_l(j)>=2lambda_l-1.
claims.exact_margin: c_l(j)-(2lambda_l-1)>=0; equality for rank1, strict for rank>=2.
claims.ratio: 2 exactly for the three spin generators.

claims.claim: Every self-compatible SU2-covariant spin3/2 channel has a full-domain canonical C2 comparator made from coherent and extreme-cat orbits.
claims.quantifiers: Every supplied legal self-compatible SU2-covariant CPTP marginal on dimension4; one comparator for every Hermitian observable.
claims.mechanism: Exact profile support r2=1, r1+r3=2, 0<=r1<=9/5; exact linear and parity star tradeoffs and rank3 spectrum.

claims.claim: The coherent/extreme-cat canonical comparator hull does not supply C2 for every legal spin5/2 covariant channel.
claims.quantifiers: One exact legal HS-positive spin5/2 channel defeats every mixture of these two orbits.
claims.broadcaster: Equation(5) from total T=5/2, BC vector (|L3>+|L5>)/sqrt2, normalized invariant projector.
claims.actual_k_upper_proof: Every pure state obeys r2+r4=2 by Kramers orthogonality.
claims.actual_k_attainer: eta=(2|5/2,5/2>+sqrt(5)|5/2,-1/2>)/3 has r2=0, r4=2; orbit barycenter I/6.
claims.scope: Not a G1/G2 counterexample; refutes only the two-orbit lift and componentwise domination by maximal-spin cloner.

claims.claim: For every half-integer spin j, highest harmonic has unrestricted support (2j+1)/2.
claims.quantifiers: All half-integer j>=1/2; every pure-state ensemble with barycenter I/(2j+1).
claims.mechanism: Time reversal Theta^2=-I forces symmetric-pair probability1/2; cat reaches maximal-spin component1/2.
claims.diagnostic_scope: Deterministic exact Racah blocks followed by floating eigenspectra for n=1,3,5,7,9,11,13,17,21,25; only n1,n3 exact top certified here.

claims.claim: Every self-compatible compact-symplectic-covariant channel on even dimension d has the uniform canonical EB full-domain C2 comparator.
claims.quantifiers: Every even d>=2; one uniform pure-state comparator for all Hermitian observables.
claims.mechanism: Two nontrivial adjoint sectors; exact odd/even star bounds and exact constant pure supports.

claims.claim: For every spin j and legal covariant joint Choi profile lambda, does an actual pure-orbit profile covariance dominate 2lambda-1 componentwise?
claims.interface: K_j=conv{r(psi)}; find r in K_j with r_l>=(2l+1)(2lambda_l-1) for all l.
claims.covariant_legal_region: Exact PSD multiplicity blocks described by SU2 Racah formulas(3)-(6).
claims.next_decisive_gate: Characterize actual symmetric-pair probability hull beyond spin3/2; spin5/2 lies in an affine plane but coherent/cat hull is already insufficient.
